title: Thallus
summary: Raleigh names Thallus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Thallus, named with Diodor and Castor among those from whom Iulius Affricanus takes the taking of Babylon, and again with Castor and Phlegon among those who find no Successour of Astyages but Cyrus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
